email.subject: Pistons Auto Care — quick site note
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked Pistons Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: it's not set up for mobile, so anyone searching for auto care on their phone (most local searches) has a hard time just finding your number or hours. And the homepage is slow to load because of heavy images, which makes people bail before they even see your services.

I fix exactly this for local shops, flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's slowing things down. Would Thursday or Friday work?

Alex
Northlight Web
